description: Form 8582 instructions (2025), Dispositions Example 1: entire interest in an actively managed rental sold for a $15,525 gain (entered in the gain facts); $2,800 current-year loss and $12,650 prior-year unallowed loss (Schedule E line 22 total $15,450); 'You have an overall gain from the disposition ($15,525 – $15,450 = $75)', so the activity stays in Part IV and line 3 is $75: every loss is allowed. AGI = 40,000 wages + 15,525 − 15,450 = $40,075.
